$comment: Pins the upstream native SDK sources that this package vendors.
The React Native package ships copies of the Android and iOS SDK sources so
that integrators do not have to add Maven/CocoaPods dependencies themselves.
Those copies are byte-identical to the standalone repositories, which means
any fix made upstream is silently absent here until someone remembers to
copy it across. `npm run sync:native:check` turns that silence into a CI
failure; `npm run sync:native` performs the copy.
`commit` is the exact upstream revision the vendored files correspond to.
NOTE: these pins currently reference a feature branch rather than main,
because the 2.0.0 hardening work these files contain has not landed on the
upstream default branches yet. Repoint `ref` to a release tag once it does.
$localOnly: These files are part of the bridge and have no upstream counterpart.
They are listed so the checker can distinguish 'local by design' from
'someone added a vendored file and forgot to register it'.
